description: ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD - a 2002 introduction (the 2002 standard's OPTIONS ARITHMETIC IS NATIVE|STANDARD) DROPPED by 2023 (Annex E.2 item 21: obsolete-but-present in 2014, removed 2023). A dual-window row: 0900 below 2002, available 2002-2014, 0807 at 2023+; Removed policy = error strict / warning permissive, aligning the removed-construct posture. STANDARD routes to the same CobolDec SDIDI engine as STANDARD-DECIMAL (the standard intermediate for its reachable operands IS the decimal form - DataBinder rationale).
citation: ISO §2023:8.8.1 / Annex E.2 item 21 (2023 defines NATIVE, STANDARD-BINARY, STANDARD-DECIMAL; STANDARD was 2002-2014, removed 2023 - use STANDARD-DECIMAL)
vcr: 2002 introduction (M2 catalog + Annex E.2 item 21 back-derivation), obsolete 2014 + 2023 removal (Annex E.2 item 21; VCR row 28)
